disclaimer.heading: Illustrative fee data — not a real BIS fee schedule
disclaimer.body: Every amount, due date, and transaction reference on this page is invented to demonstrate the interface. This prototype has no live payment gateway and no real Bureau of Indian Standards fee schedule behind it — never pay against, or treat as accurate, anything shown here. Verify actual fees directly with BIS.
